children: Accel Entertainment reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $363.56 million, net income of $20.57 million and diluted EPS of $0.25, all higher than a year earlier. For the first nine months of 2026, revenue increased 9.5% to $1.08 billion.
¹ Reported as “Total net revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to Accel Entertainment, Inc.”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per common share”.
Locations increased 5.7% year over year to 4,705, while gaming machines grew 6.6% to 29,548.
Nevada, Nebraska and Georgia posted strong growth. Illinois revenue rose 8.0%, while Nevada location hold-per-day declined.
Accel began skill-based game operations in Wyoming in October 2026 and is winding down its West Virginia operations, with completion expected in November 2028.
Management expects 2026 capital spending of $75 million to $85 million and reported no material macroeconomic impact through the first nine months. Manufacturing sales declined 62.2%.
